items.title: Documents ka folder
items.detail: Passport, visa, admit letter aur marksheets ki copies. Ek hand bag mein rakho.

items.title: Dawai aur prescription
items.detail: Regular dawaiyan aur doctor ki prescription saath rakho.

items.title: Adapter aur charger
items.detail: Wahan ka plug alag ho sakta hai. Ek universal adapter le lo.

items.title: Pehle mahine ka budget
items.detail: Rent, khaana aur travel ke liye pehle mahine ka paisa alag rakho.
